The Monitor is a monthly digest of what populist actors did around the world. It is for readers who do not follow the news every day and still want a reliable picture. It describes what happened. It does not analyse or judge. Every item links to its sources. Populism is the object of study, never the target.

## What is in an issue

1. **The month in brief.** A short general picture of the month.
2. **Around the world.** Six regions: Europe; North America; Latin America; Asia-Pacific; Middle East and North Africa; Sub-Saharan Africa. Each region has about four full items and a few one-line entries. A full item says what happened, gives the background and says what comes next.
3. **New research.** The works added to the [Library](../library/index.qmd) that month.

An issue has 15 pages at most. You can understand each event from the issue itself. The links are there as proof.

## How it is made

The Monitor follows written rules. They were set before the first issue.

- **Who is covered.** Actors that academic datasets classify as populist.
- **What counts as news.** What these actors did, not what they said: elections, governments, laws, court rulings.
- **Where the news comes from.** A fixed list of sources: nine news agencies, one specialist outlet for the European Union, regional sources and official records.
- **How it is written.** From the reports only, in plain words, without judgement.
- **Who does what.** An AI assistant searches and drafts. The editor chooses the items, edits every word and checks every link.

[Read the rules in full](rules.qmd)

## Web page and PDF

Every issue is published twice from the same text: as a web page and as a typeset PDF. The PDF is the version of record. The web page shows the PDF's page numbers in the margin, so a passage can be cited by page from either one. Each issue has its own DOI.

## How to cite

Author (year), "Title", *PopuliVerse Monitor* 2027/1, pp. x–y, DOI.

Issues are numbered by year: 2027/1, 2027/2 and so on. The Monitor is published under a [CC BY 4.0 licence](../legal/licence.qmd).
